title: Does this character's voice feel "AI-generated" to you?
author: David-Darktree-0321
selftext:
Hi everyone! I’m currently developing a Lovecraftian FPS called Remnants of R'lyeh, and I’ve been using **ElevenLabs** for the character voice-overs. While the technology is impressive, I’m at a crossroads: I want to know if the "uncanny valley" or the lack of emotional nuance is noticeable enough to warrant hiring professional voice actors.

I’m aiming for high immersion. If you feel it’s obviously AI, please let me know what specifically gave it away (cadence, breathing, emotion, etc.).

**Please tell me about your feeling:**

1. Sounds like a real human to me.
2. Sounds like high-quality AI (good, but I can tell).
3. Sounds like AI (breaks immersion).
4. Results / Just want to see.

comments.author: s_a_m_12344
comments.body: It sound great but you also have the cave eco helping, the game is always in places with eco? Then is kinda great, I'd tone down so much reverb as it sounds like a goddess talking in a dream, but for a good reference better hear how that character would sound out of the cave

comments.author: CycleMother2006
comments.body: Sounds human. Handles the inflections well (that's normally where SOTA AI struggles, inflecting incorrectly at times. But this bit of dialogue was executed without issues.)

comments.author: Plus-Glove-4850
comments.body:
I'd put this at 2.

The tone seems completely off from what it should be. She's asking "Is that why I can see you" like it's a personal question I'll be able to answer. The first line is good, feels a bit more real.

comments.author: InternationalOne2449
comments.body: I worked for elevenlabs and i could always tell. Sorry.

replies.author: David-Darktree-0321
replies.body: Thank you for your feedback, and elevenlabs is really good for sfx

replies.author: outerdead
replies.body: He probably hates hearing her voice after she dumped him.

replies.author: InternationalOne2449
replies.body: It's great. The voice cloning can be a hit or miss for weirder ones.

comments.body: AI slop will always reflect badly on you

comments.author: CaptainAlexWest

replies.body: Just used the basic text to voice. nothing fancy
